result.summary: The contractor has invoiced £125 for the checkout clean at Flat 30, 30 Harbour View (job NBL-003-2766), but the invoice can't be cleared yet. We can't check it against the approved estimate because the estimate amount isn't visible anywhere in the records. There's also no landlord approval on file, and the outgoing tenant may be the one paying (the checkout report mentions deposit deductions for cleaning). Ticket 11 looks like a duplicate of the same job, so there's a risk of paying twice. I moved the ticket to closeout, asked the contractor to resend the estimate, set a 2-day follow-up and handed the payment decision to a person.

judgement.why_this_decision: The work was approved by the agency (event 009 'Please proceed', event 010 'Estimate approved'). The contractor then invoiced (event 017; attachment-02 for £125, payee Bennett Ingram, branding Keystone Maintenance). The address, job reference and scope on the invoice all match the request. But no estimate amount is visible: the attachment on event 007 didn't come through. No landlord approval or spend limit is recorded either. My rules say I can't approve or forward an invoice I can't match to an approved quote, so a person has to decide. The contractor can resend the estimate, so I asked them for it at the same time.

alternatives_considered.option: Approve the invoice and close the ticket
alternatives_considered.why_not: There's no visible estimate amount or landlord approval to check £125 against. The payer (landlord or deposit) and the payee/trading-name link aren't confirmed, and the duplicate ticket 11 creates a risk of paying twice.

alternatives_considered.option: Ask the landlord for approval now
alternatives_considered.why_not: The work has already been done on the agency's instruction. The landlord has no contact details on file, and it isn't clear whether the landlord or the outgoing tenant's deposit should pay. That's for the agency to decide.

alternatives_considered.option: No action (thank-you or invoice notification only)
alternatives_considered.why_not: An invoice has arrived and needs reviewing. Leaving it would stall close-out.
There's no safety risk and no sign of fraud, such as a request to change bank details. Normal priority is enough.
